blueprints.license_notes: the-blueprints.com free blueprint image (contributor credited on the page). Not logged in, the site shows images at max 500 px ('Login or register to remove this restriction'); the full-size file used here is linked publicly from the same view page (no account created, nothing paid), and the same drawings are offered as free no-login downloads on the getoutlines.com mirror. Copyright stays with the contributor / original publisher (many are scans of magazine or brochure drawings) - private modelling reference only, do not redistribute. Contributor: Dr Dan Saranga.
blueprints.depicts: Carrera RS 2.7 coupe: ducktail, 'Carrera' side script, Fuchs wheels, flared rear arches, slim bumpers.
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Measured WB/L 0.536 (auto, overlay verified). Compare with official RS 2.7 figures in geometry.json (vendor preview below prints 2271/4102 = 0.554, a 3% disagreement - one of the two is off; trust the official length/wheelbase and scale by wheelbase).
blueprints.ratio_check_vs_official: measured WB/L 0.536 vs official 2271/4102 mm = 0.554 -> -3.2% : DISAGREES (>2%) - scale by wheelbase and check overhangs

blueprints.accuracy_notes: Not measured; use for detail cross-check only.

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
